name: Raise a Droppy
tagline: Raise a tiny Droppy that peeks out of the notch
description:
Raise your own little Droppy on the shelf. Time its bites, catch it as it darts about, and hold still to tuck it in: only playing the games earns the XP that grows it from a Cloud to a whole Family.

While Droppy is active it sometimes peeks out beside the notch, and calls for you when it is hungry, bored, or tired. Rumor has it someone special appears for the perfectly cared for.
